problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate computing tasks across a network of distributed data centers to minimize total processing latency.  

The available computational capacity at each source data center (set S) is as follows:  
*S1’s capacity is 158.  
*S2’s capacity is 114.  
*S3’s capacity is 166.  
*S4’s capacity is 127.  
*S5’s capacity is 100.  
*S6’s capacity is 148.  

The required workload that must be handled at each client cluster (set C) is specified below:  
*C1’s workload is 42.  
*C2’s workload is 150.  
*C3’s workload is 141.  
*C4’s workload is 116.  
*C5’s workload is 273.  
*C6’s workload is 8.  

The unit latency (in milliseconds) for transmitting a standard task unit from each source data center to each client cluster is given in the table:  

| From / To | C1 | C2 | C3 | C4 | C5 | C6 |
|-----------|----|----|----|----|----|----|
| S1        | 13 | 9  | 1  | 19 | 2  | 20 |
| S2        | 16 | 10 | 8  | 20 | 12 | 8  |
| S3        | 7  | 20 | 9  | 5  | 4  | 2  |
| S4        | 10 | 15 | 2  | 19 | 12 | 5  |
| S5        | 3  | 10 | 11 | 14 | 6  | 7  |
| S6        | 5  | 18 | 12 | 17 | 17 | 9  |

Determine the optimal distribution of tasks to minimize the total transmission latency.
